subject: What's on in E2 · 29 October – 4 November: Halloween, early
preheader: Disco and house at the Working Men's Club, plus the free and cheap nights around the station.

paragraphs: The clocks have gone back, it's dark by five, and Halloween lands on a Saturday this year, so expect the weekend to start early and finish late.
If you only do one thing, make it Friday at the Working Men's Club: disco and house from 9pm, and there are only a few tickets left.

items.blurb: Disco and house from DJ Example, with a live set from Example Live Act to break up the night. Early-bird tickets are £8, and there aren't many left.

notes_for_fred: Illustrative example only: not a real issue.
